name: The Shed
description: The big shed in the health centre precinct off Mattsson Street. It was built as a men's shed and that is still what the town calls it, but it is a multi-purpose venue now, run as part of Mallacoota District Health and Support Service: the sign above the roller door reads Mallacoota Health Centre - The Shed. It is also home to the Mallacoota Lions Club, whose own sign is on the same wall.
descriptionShort: Multi-purpose community venue in the health centre precinct, still known as the Men's Shed.

address.street: Mallacoota Health Centre precinct, Mattsson St

notes_seasonal: A venue rather than a club, so what is on there changes. The number above is the direct line to The Shed. If nobody answers it, the health service switchboard is 03 5158 0243, and bookings go through them.

source.note: Photographed 4 September 2026. The name, the health service connection and the direct line all confirmed locally.

name: Mallacoota Tennis Club
description: The tennis courts in the Lions Park precinct, beside the Mudbrick Hall and the skate park. Pickleball on Monday mornings, kids tennis on Saturday and social tennis on Sunday, all of which are on the community calendar.
descriptionShort: Tennis courts in Lions Park, with pickleball, kids and social tennis.
meetingTimes: Pickleball Monday 10am, kids tennis Saturday 9.30am, social tennis Sunday 9am

source.note: Map pin from Colin; session times from the community calendar.

notes_seasonal: The courts are in Lions Park. The old Betka Road courts are gone, so a listing or a flyer sending you to 102 Betka Road is out of date.

name: Morning Melodies
description: A monthly morning of live music and singing, played by local musicians on accordion, guitar and drum, held at the Mallacoota Hotel and listed in the Gippsland gig guide. Come for the morning rather than for a ticket.
descriptionShort: Monthly morning of live music at the Mallacoota Hotel.

source.note: Gippsland gig guide, and photographed on the morning.

name: Mudbrick Hall
description: The hall most of the town's regular groups meet in, known to everyone as the Muddie. It stands inside Lions Park, which is why it is addressed both as 1 Develling Drive and by its own pin 300 metres into the park. Line dancing, the strength and balance program, the coffee and quiz morning, chair yoga, toddler music, the community bookshop and the monthly market are all held here. It is not the Clubrooms, which is the Angling Club building a hundred metres away.
descriptionShort: The hall most of the town's regular groups meet in, known as the Muddie.

address.street: Mudbrick Hall, Lions Park, 1 Develling Dr

notes_seasonal: A venue rather than a group, so what is on there changes. Hall hire goes through Mallacoota Halls and Recreation.

source.note: Map pin from Colin; the local name and that many groups are based here, from Colin.

name: St Peter's Co-operating Church
description: Anglican and Uniting churches in co-operation, on the corner at Allan Drive. Sunday services at 9am. The parish op shop is behind the church, and the Beanie coffee van trades on the same grounds.
descriptionShort: Anglican and Uniting congregation. Sunday services 9am, op shop behind the church.
